commitNote: Final implementation head at which commands 1-8 ran. Command 9 (make verify) ran at evidenceCommit.
evidenceCommitNote: Commit at which repository-wide make verify ran. This metadata update will be a later commit, so make verify at the final head is still required.
source: Codex root reviewer runs, transcribed by Claude Opus. Only reported facts are recorded; no private identifier is included.

timestamps.note: Span of commands 1-8 at the final implementation head, millisecond resolution as reported.

repositoryVerifyReportNote: Run by the Codex root reviewer at the evidence commit. A make verify at the final head is pending.

network.note: The unit performs no network I/O; tests are pure in-memory decisions.

peer.note: No real certificate, TLS peer or peer fingerprint is used; tests use published SHA-256 vectors and synthetic bytes.
